name: hyperspell-activity
description: Logs what your Claude sessions did into the Hyperspell company brain as one reviewable activity entry per piece of work (repository and branch), written through the Hyperspell connector after a quiet period, at context thresholds, before /clear and on request. Visibility follows the share option (suggest, the default, keeps each entry yours and asks before sharing; shared posts it to the company where allowed; personal never asks; a workspace key makes every entry the company's). With handoff on, a new session lists your recent work and a number continues it. /hyperspell-activity to pause.

share.title: Share entries
share.description: suggest keeps each entry private and asks you, in your Hyperspell Inbox (or the Slack digest), whether to share it with the company; shared shares each entry with the company at once, where the workspace allows direct sharing (otherwise it falls back to suggest); personal never asks.

handoff.title: Session handoff
handoff.description: on lists your recent work in this repository when a session starts; typing its number continues that work with its Hyperspell entry and local note attached, instead of replaying the whole transcript. off (the default) keeps capture only.
